title: iOS build library
description: Point KiwiOS at one staged folder of exported IPA builds. This is public configuration and can be saved from the web Configure dialog; saving it is enough to finish setup.

library_root.title: Build library folder
library_root.description: Absolute or ~ path whose direct children are build directories. Create a folder such as ~/iOS Builds and paste that path. KiwiOS does not offer a directory picker.
library_root.warning: This path is not sandboxed. Anyone with KiwiOS on your tailnet can see the builds in this folder. Desktop and other home folders are allowed; only use a folder you mean to publish.

sort.title: Sort valid builds
sort.description: Order used by the valid-builds table.

keep_days.title: Delete builds older than
keep_days.description: Clean Old Builds deletes valid build folders older than this many days. 0 keeps them by age.

max_gb.title: Keep library under
max_gb.description: Clean Old Builds deletes oldest valid build folders until the library is under this many gigabytes. 0 does not cap size.
